notes.notes:
Added throwing weapons: for now, a wooden spear (available from every carpenter). After testing, we will add more spears and other weapon types.

notes.title: patch 0.805
notes.notes:
patch 0.805 - 14.11.2024

- Fixed confusing text when saving to clarify that nothing is being overwritten.
- Resolved a rare bug where the dialogue camera occasionally passed through the hero’s teeth.
- Ludolf continues to sell animals even after you've bought his village and confirmed that everything is fine (Note: you buy his village at the highest possible tribute, and he currently offers no quests).
- Corrected materials on a single door wall.
- Moved the info text slightly lower from the middle of the screen to avoid covering the target.
- UI information no longer blocks interaction with the rest of the game.
- Fixed the breeding bar so you can now adjust it to retain a certain number of animals in your building after breeding, rather than automatically selling them all.
- Added a safeguard to prevent naming saves in formats not supported by Windows, which previously caused a visual bug that appeared to make saves disappear.
- Fixed an equip/unequip bug where entering a UI or dialogue required a second unequip before equipping items again.
- Added decorations to Macko's Villages.
- Fixed the shoveling animation for NPCs.

**Co-op:**
- It’s recommended to start a new game to avoid cross-version bugs.
- Fixed a hotbar bug during equip/unequip actions for the client.
- Resolved the client-side kicking issue to prevent spamming and ensure damage is counted.
- Fixed a co-op save bug where the joining player could end up lying on the ground unable to stand.
- The client can now see tools in the hands of all NPCs.
- In co-op, your armor, hotbar, and items persist after death, not only the first 15.
- Items like arrows and potions now stack in loot after death.
- Improved map markers.
- UI fix: the player number bar now correctly displays 2 at the beginning of the game, rather than 1.
- Chat messages (such as “X joined the game”) now disappear after a short time.
- Pressing Enter opens and closes the chat if you type nothing.

notes.title: Robber Knight Update
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=Wy-QJV-3BVE;full][/previewyoutube]


Welcome, mighty Feudal Lords and Ladies! :)

It’s time for the Robber Knight update. It’s time to… ah, I’d better quote Skinny:

"Make Robber Knight great again!"

I wanted to start by making a list of what’s different, what’s improved, etc. While preparing that list, I realized the only thing these two games have in common is Hamish and Peterlin.

We actually made a leap of faith and, based on your feedback, created a completely new game for you. I was very nervous about it, but after the beta, I’m much less stressed, thanks to your comments:

"Otherwise, I'd like to give huge praise to the development team because I really, really like the beta. The game keeps getting better and better, and I believe it has the potential to become something truly big. Thank you for taking this bold step!"

Dom 11

I want you to know it meant a lot to us. :)

Another one from one of our first supporters, a sort of gaming friend:

"it is better to progress than to aim for perfection, for progress always happens, perfection never will."

Oberonu

And I believe progress is what you’ll see when you fire up the update.

"All is well, and I know your hard work is stressful to put out a product, but I am so glad you are taking your time and being forthright about it. >CHEERS<"

Zoryx555

So you all made sure we feel comfortable with our efforts to produce something great. We feel like the place we are in today is a great place:

to Start – the real development of the game – the real early access – with a smooth, steady progress toward the premiere. I hope you’ll feel it too.

Why such a big change

Reading your feedback made me think that something wasn’t right—that I had missed the point and uniqueness of the game.

One of our first supporters, MadKitty, was almost mad at me. And I was like, "Wtf, so much work, how can he be mad at me?"

But a real eye-opener was a video from an almost 1-million-subscriber YouTuber – Splattercatgaming. I was totally sure something had gone very wrong.

The games you were comparing us to were in a totally different direction than the original intent. I hope, for good or bad, that today’s version will show you we’re back on the Robber Knight track. And that it’s fun!

At the same time, we’re giving you the option to build, rule, and expand your lands.

We are very proud

I know I’m putting a target on my back right now, but to hell with it. We are a two-person team, and we are totally aware there is still a lot to do. But for a two-person team, I think this is foki** awesome.

Sorry for the bad language, but I feel it describes it best. And as mentioned by Oberonu, he wants to see progress, and there was so much progress that this alone makes us really proud. When you have fun, that would be heaven for us.

Thank you

We chose this ourselves, and we are very happy about it, but… You know, making games is a very hard business. I mean, you break your back over the screen for 14 hours a day, sometimes for months without a day off. And then you see comments like "this is shit," or "it’s a faking scam." It really messes with your head.

But then you get all that support from beautiful people like you, who help us find bugs, tell us to take our time, show patience, and believe that we will deliver. And you just want to keep going no matter what.

Thank you so much, mighty Feudal Lords and Ladies! :)

Your scribe and developer,  
Sartorian

Main Changes for version 0.8 - Technically, it’s really a new game, but let’s try:

- Engine Version: we are now on Unreal 5.
  
- Story: The main idea is the same: our brother betrayed us, we start from nothing. But the rest is completely different. This is Act 1 for now, and it only shows that the game world takes your actions into account.
  
- Game genre and gameplay: We are now an RPG with 4X strategy elements. So how it works: you play a normal RPG, but for your rewards (loot), you can not only buy new gear or items to make you stronger, but also an army, new technologies, or buildings to develop your land. Maybe I should use RTS instead of 4X. We’ll see how you feel about it.
  
- Complete graphic overhaul: All models, textures, and materials are new, or at least repainted or remade.

Ah, just try it out – we’re starting with the patch notes from 0.81 again.

notes.title: Patch teaser and important info
notes.notes:
Welcome dear Knights, Robber knights, Princesses and Robber Ladies!



[previewyoutube=sai71Pu-jPw;full][/previewyoutube]



This one will be short as it is just a reminder:

On July 22, we will celebrate our second anniversary. There will be a significant update and a wipe.

Why a wipe? 

- We have changed the engine version from Unreal 4 to Unreal 5. 

Why? 

- To be able to develop the game for at least another 5 years and stay competitive.

What to expect from the update:

1.	We have gathered 2 years of feedback from the 3 versions of the game we have provided, to create the ultimate gaming experience. In human language, you get a new game – based on your feedback.

2. This version, in terms of gameplay, is final. In terms of features, upgrades, and additional content, it is just the beginning of a real early access phase. So, a lot of things will be added, both planned and requested by you.

What sort of game is it now?

It's an Action RPG mixed with 4X strategies.

Basically, you roam the world, explore, fight, complete quests, and after returning to your city, you spend your wealth on upgrades, new buildings, technology, or armies.

We have cut out all the micromanagement from the game, making room for exploration and action. We have also added much more depth so you can really feel like a medieval knight and landowner.

I personally love it. But I love the vision of where we want to be in 5 years even more. I hope you will love it too.

Ready your sword for July 22!

notes.title: Update about the Update ;)
notes.notes:
Welcome Knights, Robber Knights, and Princesses,

Over the last two years, we have been conducting tests, checking, asking questions, and observing how you like to play and what type of game would please you. At the same time, we have learned a lot about game development.

Those of you who have been following us from the beginning, and there are quite a lot of you (many of your nicknames I remember from the demo times before the EA premiere), know that we have basically presented at least three different games during this period. 

Yes, that was quite an original Early Access – it's rare to have an opportunity to join a process that usually happens behind closed company doors. For that, I am really grateful, for your patience and continuous support. You have helped shape this vision.

 Last Steam Updates

They were sort of a little "trap." Yeah, sorry. I wanted to provoke a discussion among you and see how you react to certain ideas, what you really care about. Let's talk about what's coming and what we have put together from the two years of working with you.

I have made a lot of choices for the upcoming update, a lot of decisions to give you the ultimate medieval experience of being a Robber Knight or an Honorable Knight. The choice is yours.

Just so we are on the same page: Raubritters were never "Robin Hoods" chasing merchants around woods. Well, maybe they were chasing merchants around woods, but they didn't live there. They had their castles and were often the biggest lords in the neighborhood. For example, a knight called Piotr Szafraniec, who held one of the best titles in medieval Poland as the chamberlain of Krakow, was known to be one of the most brutal Robber Knights. He even took over entire castles and demanded ransom for them!

So no matter what path you choose, this will be an adventure about being a knight, alone or with your friends. I take full responsibility for the fun and adventure you will have with the next update. We finally had enough time and skill to create what we really wanted. If you don’t like it – you know who to blame 😉 haha.

 What is Coming

Complete raise in quality on every level: graphics, animations, sound, map, and characters.

1.	More action – you will get a sword in your hand within the first minute of the game.
2.	Tons of quests and dialogues.
3.	From zero to a powerful local Lord.
4.	You are a Knight, so no running around with a hatchet – that's for peasants.
5.	No micromanagement unless you want to unlock powerful bonuses, and even then, only in a limited amount. After all, we are a first-person RPG, not a city management game.
6.	Capture or buy new villages. Manage them yourself or give them into fiefdom.
7.	Your decisions and actions will determine how aggressive the game will be (even in dialogues). For example, if you choose to be a feudal lord who is a raubritter, the language will get very dirty. But if you stay at the court of an honorable knight, they will use language appropriate even for children.
8.	Deeper and more varied skill trees.
9.	The return of building your personal knight's manor with all possible furniture (optional, of course). 
10.	And the cherry on top is the new co-op mode. Let's leave it as a surprise 😉 but you will definitely be happy.

Here are some screens to give you an idea of what's coming. See you at the end of June when we will release gameplay videos. For now, we are 100% on schedule. So, July 22nd is safe. If anything changes along the way, I will inform you.

Have a great week,
Your Raubritter Sartorian 😉

notes.title: Fighting update after new year
notes.notes:
Welcome  Feudal Lords and Ladies,

We are constantly learning and one of the things we have learned so far, is not to ship half-baked updates, 

That is why we are postponing the First fighting update (there will be three) Yes finally, we fighting people will get something cool for ourselves. We postpone it to 15 January.  It will be a huge update. 
It will contain  things like, for example:

-	Types of arrows
-	Perfect block
-	Different enemy types with different behaviors
-	Caravans moving in formations
-	Your personal army that you can get into formation
-	Fighting missions
-	A second play through type for a classic raubritter – without the need of being a feudal lord with a big city to manage. 

And many other surprises.

Unfortunately, we also gave up the idea to share the current state in the beta branch - to save some more time to provide a better experience in the main update.

That is all for today
I wish you a merry Christmas and a happy new year. May your cities grow, and may your sword always be sharp!

Your scribe and developer Sartorian

notes.title: 111th Birthday! + Feudal Lord update - what did peasants find in bushes?
notes.notes:
Welcome my Old Friends and welcome new Knights

Today is our 111th birthday, and a giant update! The game will start giving out Steam cards for You :) Everything I write here you can also listen to in the video.

1. What is Raubritter now

Raubritter is an RPG-Citybuilder. The game will have 3 heroes. Two you will have available right now.


 The first Hero is, of course, you and your character.
 The second Hero is your city and your subjects.
 And the third Hero, which will come later, is your army and kingdom.


Players often describe games using other games to do this. So the plan is for a good old Stronghold to meet Skyrim and have a cup of coffee together with Mount&blade. All this from first and third person.

The game has been planned so that you can have the full experience of a feudal lord who is doing well. You start as a village headman who can barely feed his subjects, and you can go up even to become a Prince who has a vast domain.

[olist]
 The first stage is survival - city builder
 The second stage is gameplay on the world map (available from December 15)
 And in between you will be able to enjoy the storyline (available from December 2024)
[/olist]

1. The price will raise

Thank you very much for trusting us, thank you that you believed in our project from the beginning. 
I am very happy that I can remember so many of you from the very beginning. 

We already have as many players as we assumed for the entire early access. Therefore, the price wanders to the final price. After the current promotion ends. Thank you for your support.

2. What are we focusing on now

The current stage of the game is fully focused on making the economic system as enjoyable for you as possible. And to make it easier to manage your domains. You have nobility ranks available, which unlock new buildings and new production opportunities for you. 

While you "investigate" whether you are sure everything is satisfactory and report to us when you are possibly bored. We will prepare a new combat system and combat missions for you. 
There will also be a surprise update – somewhere in between. Probably next month.

3. When will the third person finally arrive?

The third person will come with the next update, which is December 15, 2023. Now it would not make sense because we plan to replace the entire animation system.

4. In co-op am I still tethered with the host? 

In co-op you can freely run all over the map without worrying about where the host is. However, I point out that the game is a co-op. Not PVP, not MMO. CO-op means that you have common colors, common village and common resources. That's how it was planned and that's how it will stay. Maybe Raubritter 2 will also give a PVP option, but it is not planned at this point. 


5. Will there be more wipes?

We won't be forcing any more wipes, but it's possible that in order to get access to all the new features from future updates, you may have to start over.  But I promise the starting over will be fun.

Anyway, we will make the current version available in the beta-branch. So, if you don't like updates. Just switch to the beta-branch and you will be 100% safe. Especially that we are still noobs and the early access god may punish us. 


The Feudal Lord update - let's get a little nerdy

In this update, we have focused on grasping the experience of being a Feudal Lord in medieval Europe. And that contains some fascinating areas. First building up your village. What was a fun fact to discover was, that most knights were pennyless, and they armor and sword were often the only assets they had.

But we wanted to show the way from a poor sort of solider to the top of the feudal ladder, Which did not happen really often, but there were cases of some great from zero to hero carriers in the medieval ages.

So not counting some firstborns of noble families, they had to earn everything themselves as mercenaries or when they were more lucky as hard workers on their tiny piece of land.

The theme of building a village contains some interesting parts as well. Where from should I get new peasants. In the period the game takes place it was pretty easy because it is right before the black death period, so there was a lot of people in Europe. 

But you had to care about them, because they would run away from bad masters, under the care of big so-called free cities, that started to develop very fast in this time.

There was even a saying that "City air makes free."

So building your village, recruiting, and carrying about your villagers. But villagers are the easy part – what about craftsman? Skilled blacksmiths, carpenters, builders etc. That was a thought theme, which a knight had to solve as well.

There is of course the matter of social rank, of responsibilities connected to it, taxes – providing an army for your liege.  I don't want to spoiler too much, but we made sure that takes place in the game right now and will be developed further. Of course, somewhere in the corner, dangers are lurking. Raubritters, pagans, mongol raids, foreign raids or just aggressive neighbors. 


A little more about what is new

First, we decided to Focus on the theme of becoming a feudal Lord and a Knight. 

So social ranks, building up your small medieval city, castle and army are all connected now.

As you know, the story will come in at the end, but we have already added at least a nice prologue. Explaining, why, as a knight you are tossed into the middle of the forest.

Some quests helping you to grasp the story of the world you are in. Which is medieval Poland, Silesia, under the rule of the Czech king Wenceslas the second, are coming as a surprise about around next month.

I don’t want to make any spoilers, but the story will spin around the thread of two big political camps that crushed in middle Europe in that time, and it is the Czech Premyslid dynasty and the Pope with many dynasties around him that did not like the fact of the Premyslid being so powerful. 

How a lonely knight was caught in such a big chess game? Well, you will have to discover yourself on our premiere after the early access.

Back to the game

So your new Land that you will receive from Hamish is the center point of the game. This is the place where you build, hire new peasants, build up your army, trade with the world and decide when to move out for the quests of the main story and other fun activities.

Of course, there is a road on which you can meet the caravans.

So I have reveled the next fact. Which is a new map

I have made the graphics and color pallet more realistic. Made sure that the map fits into the gameplay needs. Made place for some adventures in it. But its main reason is for you to build your city on it. 

The game will contain a lot of smaller maps for the story and quests to take part in it. We decided for the smaller maps because of 2 reasons.

1.	Quests maps fit better as a connection between RPG with a story and the Building strategy part of the game

2.	We are a small studio, so we are not so good at squeezing everything there is from the engine like the AAA studios. So the smaller maps will make it easier for us, not having to sacrifice the graphic quality so much. 


Thank you for your time. 
And for those of you who still look for the answer
what did peasants find in bushes?

The patch notes of course. I hope you you will forgive me that little clickbait. Have a nice day :)

notes.title: Chapter 21: Next update 16 July or June - Details in the article
notes.notes:
Welcome, Noble Lords and Ladies,

This one is a quick one as we are fully focused on the upcoming update and in a small company every second counts.  The next update both game and written will be on 16 June or even 16 July. If you feel the need to ask if we are still alive - join us on Discord, we are there almost every day.

Reasons why it will take longer, to deliver all this great things we talked about last month.

1. Co-op

Maybe best on an example.  For every day of work for the single player, there are 6 days of work for co-op. I think I don't need to say more.

If we would first make a single player game, then add co-op to it. Not only half of you would be mad. But also we would go bankrupt, because adding co-op later is even more work consuming.

We are also working on removing host tethering completely. So brace up. It is worth the wait.

New game

We don't want to deliver a simple update but a completely new experience. So we are taking care also about every detail that was neglected so far. Like icons, sounds, UI, language bugs etc., etc.

Chain of fixes

We got to a point. Where adding or fixing one thing makes no sense without adding another one. So for example we started to make premade buildings with NPCs working in them, this NPCs of course have needs like warm, drinking, food. So we realized that you have no chance of feeding them without animals. And you have no chance of feeding the animals without fields. And I could write about 100s of chains like this.


Finish

We work hard to get the game to a point. Where we don't have to do more forced wipes. And where making a "walkthrough" or "how to" will make sense, because the game will get new stuff, not rework the old things.


Have a great month. And I hope to hear again from you in July, when we will celebrate our 1st birthday.

notes.title: Chapter 17 - Update 0.33a Performance + Translation
notes.notes:
Welcome back in the new year!

As you know, this project has been planned for 5 years, because thanks to our cooperation with you, the list of ideas has grown considerably longer than the original and literally everything has changed - including the developer.
In the last post, we informed you that we need about 7 months, to go through the next two points on the road-map.

0.34 - All found bugs fixed, Fast travel from certain places with carts, water buckets and wine skin to fill in the river, return of the bigger premade buildings.
0.35 - Added community suggestions like 3rd person, controller support, numbers on hot bars, turning off head bob etc. Level system based on doing an activity. Life AI or pre-built buildings so that those non-builders can also enjoy the magnificent knight mansions.

Early Access

This is a very specific state of the game. Where the player has to show a lot of trust in the developer that the developer will not abandon the project and the developer often has to grit his teeth reading unflattering comments, even though he knows the product is not even halfway there.
However, it's this specific form that allows us to stay on top of things with you and ultimately deliver a game that we will all be proud of. 

Let me remind you again that this is version 0.33, a very early alpha. This means that a great many things will be added and a lot of activities will be smoothed out. And again thank you for your support, all of you who understand this, support us strongly, and cheer.

I am less active in interacting with you

It costs a lot of time to make a game, so I just can't write back to everyone, but I'm reading, checking the recordings, and looking for what annoys you in the game so that we don't duplicate these mistakes in the next update. 

And again, many thanks to Bender, Skinny, JoeFried, Han solo, Mad Kitty, Oberonu, Opi-Alt for all the hard work in building our comunity in particular on discord - https://discord.gg/Vy3amSjDfT you are welcome whether for help or to submit your ideas/needs

Trouble with castle construction

 Due to the fact that there is no possibility of terraforming in the project (we are considering the possibility of adding this to the game. It is recommended that you begin castle construction by laying the foundations in the construction area. 
Towers

To add towers to the walls you need to start with a proper connector for either the round tower or the diamond tower. Unfortunately, at this point a tower can be a connector between walls, a corner, or a junction, there is no possibility of other snap towers.

Your humble scribe and developer

notes.notes:
So - for game destroying bugs, that is it. Not counting the building system that we are making much bigger and smoother, there are only some minor bugs left. So GOOD news - time for content updates.

But the content updates, to make it fascinating for you, will take us more time - to check and prepare. So we are switching to a Biweekly update period. But starting with the CO-op update.

So the next update will happen between 2-15 September 2022, ofc. But I will continue to post a note every week on Friday with things that are coming. 

Why you need so much time for the next?

What is coming with the CO-OP update

- CO-OP (with password protected lobbies)
- New Map
- Bigger (many new pieces for the modular part) and smoother building system
- New premade buildings
- A lot of decorative items
- New Textures (I cleaned up everything properly, so you should not have problems on older PCs)

- The villagers will have their routines
- More quests
- Quests and Knowledge journal with how to do what in game (In journal)
- New weapons
- Better guides for the player, and difficulty areas. But less inviting for I WANT IT NOW type of people.
- And some surprises from the work-in-progress list and community-request list
- New building materials

5 types of stone-type building material: Brick, Granite, Slate, Sandstone, Limestone

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42091718/415904b230bc6827e1df365ad22452ad00b18dc3.png

5 types of trees: elm (for bows, ropes), birch (health brews, tar, tableware, furniture, coal), Pine (Buildings), Poplar (Furniture, little buildings, barrels, Spruce (shields, fortifications)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42091718/48a3b99515a690f46aa5883cd54c65b4ed598591.png

Even more less inviting for I WANT IT NOW type of players.

We are not here to make tons of money. Maybe it will happen, but it does not matter. We are here to make a game - that people who are engaged in our project will love. 

And by reading those of you who are really engaged (The majority, of course, not 100%). You would like to have more layers of the crafting - leveling system. More decisions into what shall I pick to get what I want etc. etc. 

So if you are a type of player - I started the game - I want to beat a knight in full armor and burn a village. Sorry, this is not a place for you. This is or rather will be a place for old school gamers - with patience, willing to make up a plan, build a camp - and then decide how to get to it. Our hope is that we will - install some of this virtues in younger people. 

But we will move the knights in the more difficult areas. We just thought that it is pretty obvious, even without a skull flying over his head. That a knight in a full plate armor was a mighty opponent at this time and on level one(1-20) you will not be able to beat him. We are willing to learn and change all the time. Despite the fact, some of you might consider us dinosaurs as we started our gaming carrier on something called Amiga.

If of course we have misinterpreted your wishes - tell us right away - we started so early, so we can be fully flexible and grant your wishes true.

notes.title: Time to put on the armor and pull out your sword . Version 0.3 launched!
notes.notes:
Time to put on the armor and pull the ancestral sword off the wall. It's time to saddle your horse and set off to meet the adventures and threats that have arisen.

Set up a camp in a medieval forest and make a choice:


 Do you want them to praise your name in songs?
 Do you want the jealous ones to whisper on the streets of cities about your craft skills?
 Or maybe you prefer to spread fear in the hearts of your enemies?


Whatever you want, it is your world, your medieval life - you choose.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1887020/Raubritter

That is a 0.3 version of the game. We launched it so early because we want to make sure, we create a game „every” medieval fan will like to play, and life in it, not just us.
Co-op is incoming next month, might be 2 months. So if you are after this feature – buy only if you want to support us.

What we promise:

- Hard work
- Listening to your suggestions (we have a clear vision for the game but You are the important one not us. So if the community will want something in the game, we are here to please you.)
- Good comunication ( we will not hide behind a castle wall from you. We are here, we want to listen, we want to get better in every aspect)
- Sticking with the project  (we started this project with a idea to create a medieval world „to live in”. We are very happy so many of you share this dream. We promise to finish it and than develop it further.

When not to buy:

- When you want a finished product. ( it is a 0.3 – work in progres, so basic things, might still miss)
- When bugs drive you mad instead of make you laugh
- When you don’t like Indie studios. (We are a small studio, with big ambitions. But if you are to reaching for the top, you can fall down. We will get up and try again, but maybe you don’t want to wait for this.)
